question.text: Regulation 91E explicitly requires that when a listed project's AIR has been assessed by a SIA, the Social Enterprise must:

answer.text: Suppress the SIA's report to avoid confusing investors - only the AIR is disclosed.
Disclose the SIA's report only upon specific request from SSE.
Disclose the SIA's report only if it contains an adverse opinion.
Disclose the SIA's report ALONG WITH the AIR.

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 91E(7) (as cited in the workbook) requires: 'The AIR shall be assessed by Social Impact Assessors and the SEs shall disclose the report of the Social Impact Assessors along with AIR.' This is a mandatory co-disclosure - the SIA's report is a first-class public document. The Trap: Suppression, adverse-only disclosure or request-based disclosure each defeats the transparency rationale of Reg 91E and are not permitted. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C tests auditor's report co-disclosure with financial results. XXIII extends that rule to SIA's report co-disclosure with AIR. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When finalising Form 3.1, give the NPO two clean copies - one for filing with SSE and one for public-website co-publication under 91E(7). Any 'edited' version on the website vs SSE raises a serious disclosure-asymmetry red flag.
